page.overview:
Who is Kai Brightstar?

Kai Brightstar was a human male Jedi youngling sent to the forest planet Tenoo for training during the High Republic Era.

Kai Brightstar was a human male Jedi youngling Coruscant at the Jedi Temple, where they learned under Jedi Masters Yoda and Zia Zaldor Zanna. it came time for the younglings to continue their training elsewhere, and Brightstar, Solay, and Nubs were assigned to travel to the planet Tenoo in the Outer Rim Territories. However, when Yoda announced this to the larger younglings, the three were missing, off practicing in the training course—Brightstar had had the idea of making one last attempt at their record before departing.

The trio hid behind cover while strategizing how to get beyond the training remote droids and capture a beacon. Solay decided to leap to one side of the course, drawing the droids' fire and allowing Brightstar and Nubs to make a break for the beacon. Using Nubs's paws as a jump-off point, Brightstar flipped toward the beacon and began walking backwards to it, deflecting the droids' lasers with his lightsaber. He declined when his friends offered to help but then tripped, prompting them to come to his aid anyhow. Solay reminded him that friends existed to help one another, which Brightstar affirmed—he had thought he could do it by himself. They continued blocking laserfire from the droids until Brightstar was close enough to grab the beacon, which he did—they had broken their record, much to their celebration, though Nubs's hug was too tight for Brightstar.

Master Zanna then appeared on a hologram, warning the younglings that they would need to hurry to their shuttles to Tenoo. Brightstar apologized for their tardiness. They caught the last shuttle, where the pilot, the human Nash Durango, and her droid, RJ-83, were making repairs before they left. Brightstar asked who the pilot was, and when Durango told them it was her, Solay was surprised, for she was a mere child. Durango pointed out that the Jedi, too, were kids, and she introduced herself, receiving the younglings' names in return. They boarded her starship, the Crimson Firehawk, and took off to jump into hyperspace, delighting the Jedi.
